module up_counter8(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output [7:0] count
);

reg [7:0] shift_reg;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        shift_reg <= shift_reg; // No change when rst is high
    end else begin
        shift_reg <= {shift_reg[6:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left and insert 0 LSB
    end
end

assign count = shift_reg;

endmodule

module LFSR (out, clk, rst);
  input clk, rst;
  output reg [3:0] out;

  reg [1:0] stage;  // Tracks current waiting stage (0 for first, 1 for second)
  reg [3:0] buffer; // Buffer to hold product when first factor is processing

  always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      out <= 4'b0;
      stage <= 2'b0;
      buffer <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      if (stage == 2'b0) begin
        // First factor is ready
        if (out[0] == 0) begin
          buffer <= out[0];    // Save product
          out <= 4'b0;        // Clear output
          stage <= 2'b1;        // Move to second factor handling
        end else begin
          out <= out >> 1;  // Shift partial result
          stage <= 2'b0;        // Return to first factor
        end
      end else begin
        // Second factor is ready
        if (buffer[0] == 0) begin
          out <= buffer >> 1; // Update output with scaled buffer
          stage <= 2'b0;        // Return to first factor
        end else begin
          out <= out + buffer; // Add scaled buffer to output
          stage <= 2'b0;        // Reset stage for next cycle
        end
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
